items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: Just like my uncle, both of my uncles, Johnny Dodds, he left and his uncle through second marriage.

ctx.x: So how did Tick get played? Was he a high note man?

No, I'll tell you, he played on a style like Buddy P.T., right? On a style like Schalke played, he was that kind of trumpet player. A real nice trumpet player. And he stayed around Chicago, he stayed around Chicago and died. He left here and never did come back. Never came back. Never did come back to New Orleans anymore. Just like my uncle, both of my uncles, Johnny Dodds, he left and his uncle through second marriage.
I was going to ask you how they were related. Baby once mentioned something about it, too. I didn't know just how you were related.
